# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest released version of Arcantry.

## Report a vulnerability

Please use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/MrMaxie/arcantry/security/advisories/new). Include the affected command or package surface, expected impact and the smallest reproduction you can share safely.

Do not open a public issue for an undisclosed vulnerability. You can expect an initial response within seven days.
